--- layout: dilemma permalink: /dilemmas/virtue-jerusalem-to-jericho/ title: "Jerusalem to Jericho" summary: "With plenty of time before class, you pass by a distressed person slumped against a wall, coughing and groaning." ---

You are walking across campus to get to a class in which you are scheduled to give a presentation. You got to campus early and you have plenty of time before class. As you pass a lecture center building, you see a man slumped against a wall, coughing and groaning.

What do you do?

Source: John M. Darley & C. Daniel Batson, 1973
